Our former Thruxton Fender Eliminator kit, the A3T, was only compatible with up to 2015 model year bikes. As a result, we had to come up with something new. It also gave us an opportunity to make the newer kit even better than the last. Using 3/8″ 6061 aluminum, premium integrated LED lights, and OEM quality plug and play connectors and wrapping it all in high quality craftsmanship, we decided to knock it out of the park.

Completely redesigned for 2016 and newer model year Thruxtons, the A3T v2 is a Thruxton Fender Eliminator kit equipped with integrated running light, brake light, license plate light and turn signals controlled by a custom made circuit. This kit lightens the tail of your Thruxton with virtually no fuss.

name: Analog LED Indicators for Triumph Street Twin

description: Analog Motor Goods has developed a compact super bright LED turn signal. We have developed these special plug-and-play kits for your Street Twin, Street Cup,… • Easy plug & play install. • Super bright Amber LEDs. • Waterproof. • Heavy duty metal body.
source_description_html:
Analog Motor Goods has developed a compact super bright LED turn signal. We have developed these special plug-and-play kits for your Street Twin, Street Cup, Street Scrambler and Bobber front signals. The Analog Signal Pods are powerful mini indicators that are discreet until illuminated. Their low profile and robust construction keep them on par with the rest of the quality parts we here at Analog Motor Goods are known for.  Pairs well with the Retro Lighting Kit. Manufactured by Denali Electronics. These are great replacements for the best selling Watsen Design ST indicators, from the now closed Watsen Designs.

  • Easy plug & play install
  • Super bright Amber LEDs
  • Waterproof
  • Heavy duty metal body
  • Built in voltage regulator
  • No need for resistors
  • Mounting hardware included
  • Power Draw: 6 Watts per signal (12W Pair)
  • Pod Size: 1.45″ (36.8mm) x 0.73″ (18.5mm) x 0.55″ (14mm)

Included in the Box:

  • 1 x pair of signals
  • 2 x 5mm washers
  • 2 x 5mm x 10mmAllen Head Bolts
